offending_extra_words: at IBM's option, re-performance of the non-conforming Services
EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY WARRANTED IN SECTION 5.1,
reasons: Fallback fails on material terms: no 30-day (or any) Services warranty period is created — the inserted warranty covers only "each Materials deliverable and Base Component", leaving performance of the Services with no conformance warranty or period.
Conformance is qualified: "conform in all material respects to its applicable documentation" is weaker than the required documentation conformance, so the fallback conformance element is not met.
No professional or workmanlike standard is added; the untouched clause retains only "reasonable care and skill", so that fallback element remains unmet.
Remedy set is diluted: "at IBM's option, re-performance" adds a vendor-elected alternative beyond repair, replace and refund, weakening the customer's remedy.

Not minimal: the insertion adds "and specifications" and a re-performance remedy that the level does not require, and Operation 2 rewrites the disclaimer opener (9→16 words) where a tighter carve-out would suffice.

Intent problems: the insertion is numbered "c." while the existing disclaimer paragraph is also "c.", creating duplicate lettering and cross-reference ambiguity, and "Base Component" is used as a defined term with no resolved definition in the Agreement.

Suggested fix: keep numbering unique, drop "in all material respects", "and specifications" and the re-performance option, and add an express 30-day warranty that the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner measured from performance/completion.
